summary: eslint-plugin-folder-schema ships a preinstall dropper that fetches the Bun runtime to execute a 728 KB obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares preinstall="node setup.mjs". setup.mjs is itself obfuscated (hex-prefixed identifiers, string-indirection objects) and, at install time, downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases into a temp directory (platform/libc detection selects the asset, chmod 0755), then invokes `bun math_init.js` against a sibling file in the package. math_init.js is a 727,680-byte single-line JavaScript bundle obfuscated in the obfuscator.io style (rotating string-array `n7gIxM`, shuffle helper `WV8StW`, mangled globals), whose semantics cannot be read without executing it. The package presents itself as an ESLint folder-schema plugin authored by ServiceTitan (homepage points to github.com/servicetitan/folder-lint), but the shipped lib/index.js is a thin ~40-line wrapper around `folder-lint` unrelated to setup.mjs or math_init.js. Fetching an alternate language runtime at preinstall solely to execute an in-package obfuscated blob is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern; the obfuscation of both the loader and the payload conceals what runs on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
